rationale: Identity verification was correctly performed using name and zip, and the agent looked up the correct orders and available variants. The agent gathered and confirmed item-level exchange details and the preferred alternative payment method before executing exchanges, and the tool results show the exchanges were placed with the requested Visa (6791), matching what was confirmed. However, two significant policy violations occurred: (1) The user confirmed canceling only the skateboard item, but the agent proceeded to cancel the entire pending order without explicitly informing the user of that change or obtaining confirmation for full-order cancellation. (2) The final message stated the refund for the cancellation would go to Mastercard (8484), but the tool shows the refund was issued to Visa (6791), so the agent provided incorrect final information and did not honor the requested payment method for cancellation. These issues breach the requirements to confirm exact changes before writes and to provide accurate, tool-supported final information.
